_comment: Public one-sentence descriptions of the designs the checker rejects (site/build.py, "What does not count"), keyed by the stem of the file in tests/<task>/negative/ (`negatives`) or tests/<task>/attacks/ (`attacks`). Every negative and attack of tests/expected.json that the checker rejects needs one; the stage comes from tests/expected.json. The internal notes there are never shown.

negatives.add_proc_case: A correct adder whose carry cell is a `case` arm wrapped in `begin … end`, a shape the proof's tactics do not handle, so its proof leaves a goal unproved.
negatives.carry_bug: A wrong carry gate, `(a & b) | (c & a)`.
negatives.cin_name: The carry-in port is named `ci` instead of `cin`.
negatives.cout_off: The carry out is taken one bit too early (`c[N-1]`).
negatives.dead_clock: A correct sum stored in flip-flops on a clock that nothing drives: every simulator sees `x`, and it would score 0 GE.
negatives.dead_clock_tied: The same with the clock tied to `1'b0`: a clock must be an input port.
negatives.only_n16: A ripple adder at the scoring width N = 16 only, wrong at every other width.
negatives.plus: The right function through the banned run-time `+`.
negatives.wide_s: One (N + 1)-bit output `{cout, s}` instead of the two ports `s` and `cout`.

attacks.eqx_undriven: Compares an undriven signal with `===`, which Yosys folds to a constant.
attacks.eqx_x: `(cin === 1'bx) ? '0 : sum`: a 4-state simulator computes the sum, while Yosys folds the test and outputs 0 at 0 GE.
attacks.slang_always_notime: A plain `always` block that never advances time, which the language forbids (it deadlocks a simulator) but Yosys reads as a wire.
attacks.slang_initial_comb: An `initial` block and an `always_comb` both writing `cout`, which the language forbids but Yosys accepts.
attacks.slang_input_assign: Assigns to the input port `cin`, which the language forbids.
attacks.slang_mixed_assign: Drives `cout` from both a continuous assignment and an `always_comb`, which the language forbids.
attacks.slang_two_always: Two `always_comb` blocks writing `cout`, which the language forbids.
attacks.z_case_item: A correct sum behind a `case` item with a `z` digit, which Yosys reads as a match, turning the output into an unknown value at 0 GE.
attacks.zpair_add_rare: Complementary `z` items that make the netlist wrong on a single input pair, too rare for sampling to find.
